document.title: Record vendored patches; upload_vita syncs emoji assets
document.summary: Two stories: `vendor/PATCHES.md` records every local patch to vendored code, and the Vita `upload_vita` target now also uploads `assets/emoji`.

sources.title: Track and minimise local patches to vendored code (stb_ds seed fix)
sources.gist: Record every vendor patch in one place; check whether the stb_ds fix can live in src/.

sources.title: upload_vita does not push assets/emoji
sources.gist: upload_vita only sends the binary, so emoji are missing without a full VPK install.

parts.name: Vendor patches
parts.summary: One file lists the stb_ds, jimp and quickjs patches with upstream versions, reasons and replay steps; the stb_ds patch stays.

parts.name: Emoji upload
parts.summary: `upload_vita` uploads the Twemoji PNGs through one curl config, skipped by a stamp until they change.

groups.title: Vendor patch inventory
groups.why: Patched vendor files drift from upstream and make updates risky, so every patch is recorded in one place ([#87](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `vendor/PATCHES.md` becomes the single record, and the jimp README and ADR 0003 now point to it instead of keeping their own list.

groups.title: stb_ds.h back to upstream's trailing newline
groups.why: The issue asks to remove the stb_ds patch if possible; it could not be removed, so the diff against upstream is shrunk to the marked change ([#87](source:s1)).
groups.summary: The only edit restores the final newline, so `diff` against upstream v0.67 shows just the `VitaDeck:` seed change.

groups.title: upload_vita uploads assets/emoji
groups.why: After a code-only upload a Vita without a prior VPK install renders emoji as missing ([#93](source:s2)).
groups.summary: Configure writes `upload_emoji.curl` listing every PNG, and a stamp-guarded custom command that runs it becomes a dependency of `upload_vita`; the build skill documents the stamp.
lookFor: Subtle: the emoji step is a dependency of `upload_vita`, so it runs before the `destroy` command while the old app is still running.
Subtle: the stamp only tracks this build directory and Vita IP, so removing the app from the Vita and then running `upload_vita` skips the emoji until `out-vita/upload_emoji-<ip>.stamp` is deleted.
The PNG list is globbed at configure time, so images downloaded after configure are not uploaded until CMake reconfigures.

commits.subject: build(vita): upload_vita also uploads assets/emoji
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
A code-only upload never sent the Twemoji images, so a Vita without a full VPK install showed no emoji. Configure now writes a curl config listing every image, and upload_vita runs it once (one curl process, one FTP connection, a progress counter) before relaunching. A stamp per build directory and Vita IP skips the step until the images change, so normal iterations stay fast.

Fixes #93

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: chore(vendor): record every local patch to vendored code
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Add vendor/PATCHES.md with the upstream version, diff summary, reason and replay steps for the three patches in vendor/: the stb_ds.h seed race fix (#81), the two jimp.h Vita warning fixes, and the "Vita" commit on the quickjs submodule fork. arena.h, raylib.h and stb_truetype.h match upstream byte for byte.

The stb_ds patch stays: no STBDS_* option disables the per-table seed advance, a startup seed is overwritten by every later table, and hash maps are created on both the JS and main threads. TSan on snapshot_swap_harness reports the race with the upstream header and runs clean with the patched one. The patched header gets back upstream's trailing newline so the diff is only the marked change.

Fixes #87

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
